source: Raw game client payloads (messageType DATA_DATA) for one planet and one system, captured 2026-08-16. Kept for the SCHEMA, not for Aurum — QJ-650 is not a system this campaign uses. Trimmed to the orbital and stellar fields; build costs, fees, influence and workforce blocks were dropped as irrelevant here.
headline: The game serves full-precision orbital elements. Every element the damage model derives by hand is available exactly, and the rounding in raukk_orbits.json is the single dominant error in position prediction today.

orbitObject.absent: No mean anomaly, no epoch, no timestamp anywhere in either payload. Position at a given instant is therefore NOT derivable from this data alone — the clock still has to come from observation, which is what the three-system map fit supplies.
orbitObject.allZero: rightAscension and periapsis are 0 for all four QJ-650 planets. That directly confirms the perifocal convention raukkPlanetPosition assumes (argument of periapsis along +x) and says ascending nodes share a direction. Combined with the absent mean anomaly, the schema itself is evidence for a global clock with M = 0 at epoch — the assumption the map fit verified observationally.

assetRelationship.finding: raukk_orbits.json stores round(game.semiMajorAxis / 1e6), i.e. the axis rounded to integer thousands of km. Verified exactly on all four QJ-650 bodies: 62179706000 -> 62180, 112176114000 -> 112176, 203667298000 -> 203667, 633129656000 -> 633130.
assetRelationship.eccentricity: asset rounds to 4 decimals; game carries full float
assetRelationship.starMass: already fine — asset 2.815068698011492e30 against game 2.8150686328867583e30, agreeing to 2.3e-8, so mass is not a contributor
assetRelationship.meteoroidDensity: asset rounds to 6 significant figures (2.96813 vs 2.9681285287624033)
assetRelationship.luminosity: NOT the same quantity — the asset's 6164.86 is the derived Sunlight x orbitAU^2, the game's 4.508031745107532 is the star's own luminosity

phaseErrorRemoved.comment: Phase error today from axis rounding alone, against what remains once exact elements are used (star-mass residual only)
phaseErrorRemoved.reading: Roughly a 2,700x reduction on the worst bodies. The per-body phase corrections logged as the thing to build are superseded: this is a data ingest, not a fitting campaign, and it fixes every body at once rather than only observed ones.

otherFieldsWorthHaving.inclination: Present, and small — QJ-650 spans -1.47 to +0.91 degrees. This REFUTES the standing claim that no source carries an inclination. The coplanar assumption turns out to be right to within a degree or two rather than merely assumed, and it is now measurable per body instead of being the thing that made rho computable only by fiat.
otherFieldsWorthHaving.radiation: Per-planet scalar (6.22127e-22 on QJ-650a), alongside temperature, pressure and magneticField. Bears directly on the section 7.5 defect where heat and radiation are merged into one stellar term — that defect was recorded as measurable only by differencing shielded and unshielded BTF flights, and a per-planet radiation field is a second, independent handle on it.
otherFieldsWorthHaving.starPosition: x/y/z at full precision, against fio_systemstars.json's existing PositionX/Y/Z
otherFieldsWorthHaving.planetMass: mass and massEarth per planet, not currently carried anywhere
